verdict.rationale: GitBook documents an official CLI that lets users list organizations, inspect spaces and pages, ask questions against their docs, and build and publish integrations from the shell. The community quote saying the CLI is "no longer under active development" comes from an old README about the legacy open-source book-building tool. It does not concretely contradict the current CLI, so it lowers confidence rather than creating a dispute. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the current CLI, documented agent-oriented details (e.g. machine-readable output, non-interactive auth), and in-depth command reference evidence.
